name: 🫓 Greek Chicken Naan & Tzatziki
tagline: Lemony, garlicky chicken on warm naan with a cool homemade cucumber tzatziki.

steps.text: Marinate: chicken with 2 Tbsp oil, juice of 1 lemon, 2 cloves grated garlic, oregano, 1 tsp salt and pepper. 15 minutes is plenty.
Tzatziki: grate 2 cucumbers, squeeze out the water in a towel, then stir into the yogurt with 1 grated garlic clove, chopped dill, a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Slice the tomatoes and the rest of the cucumbers.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet or grill pan over medium-high until 165°F inside.
Warm the naan in the oven or directly in the skillet.
Build: naan, a big spoon of tzatziki, chicken, tomatoes, cucumbers, lemon.

kid_jobs.job: Grate the cucumbers and squeeze them dry
Stir up the tzatziki and taste it
Pick and chop the dill with kid scissors

chef_tip: Squeeze the grated cucumber hard in a towel. Wet cucumber makes thin, watery tzatziki; dry cucumber makes it thick and restaurant-good.
make_ahead: Tzatziki keeps 3 days and gets better. Marinate the chicken in the morning.
leftovers: Chicken + tzatziki over rice or greens, or tucked in a wrap for lunch.
serve_with: Castelvetrano or Kalamata olives, feta if we have it

game_plan.what: Kids grate cucumber for tzatziki; slice tomatoes.
Chicken out to rest. Naan warming.
Slice the chicken; set out tzatziki and veggies.
